pw = {p['account_name']: p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
amazon_token = apis.amazon.login(username='nicholas.weber@gmail.com', password=pw['amazon'])['access_token']
fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username='nicholas.weber@gmail.com', password=pw['file_system'])['access_token']

folder = '~/bills/shopping_amazon/'

filename_by_order = []
for o in all_orders:
    created_at = o['created_at']
    ordered_at_date = created_at.split('T')[0] if isinstance(created_at, str) else str(created_at)
    file_name = f"ordered-at-{ordered_at_date}-order-id-{o['order_id']}.txt"
    file_path = folder + file_name
    filename_by_order.append((o['order_id'], ordered_at_date, file_path))

print('orders_count', len(filename_by_order))
print('sample_3', filename_by_order[:3])

# check if sample files already exist
checks = []
for order_id, ordered_at_date, file_path in filename_by_order[:3]:
    exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token).get('exists')
    checks.append((order_id, file_path, exists))
print('sample_existence_checks', checks)
